answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware enclave that signs one unforgeable attestation per epoch, carrying a rotating cipher key derived from a monotonic nonce. A farmer must purchase one physical secure element per account, so mass cloning collapses like a karst cavern depleted of recharge. Nonces never repeat, so replaying an identity requires fresh silicon every epoch; peers verify the attestation plus a juniper-grade minimal host check. Sustained capex per seat makes sybil economics unprofitable.
